tool_description: Navigate to a URL

launchOptions.description: PuppeteerJS LaunchOptions. Default null. If changed and not null, browser restarts. Example: { headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox'] }

allowDangerous.description: Allow dangerous LaunchOptions that reduce security. When false, dangerous args like --no-sandbox will throw errors. Default false.

server_level_metadata.server_description: Official MCP server for Puppeteer browser automation, web page navigation, interaction, and screenshot capture

static_checks.behavioral_directive_details: None. Technical description of browser URL navigation.
static_checks.hidden_prerequisites: Requires local Chromium installation; optional allowDangerous flag allows bypassing security args
static_checks.unauthorized_data_transfer_risk: high: Can perform arbitrary HTTP GET navigation to any internet or local intranet URL
static_checks.purpose_implementation_match: MATCH: Description accurately reflects browser page navigation.

audit_evidence: index.ts line 279 calls page.goto(args.url). Line 122 defines allowDangerous boolean parameter. Lines 150-165 enforce DANGEROUS_ARGS check but allow caller to bypass via allowDangerous: true.
security_concerns: 1) Arbitrary URL navigation can access internal intranet endpoints or cloud metadata (169.254.169.254 - SSRF). 2) allowDangerous parameter enables disabling Chromium sandbox (--no-sandbox, --disable-web-security).
reviewer_rationale: Tool is legitimate and accurately implemented. However, the allowDangerous parameter and arbitrary URL traversal represent high-risk attack surfaces. It requires gateway policy validation (blocking private IPs and blocking allowDangerous: true) rather than unconditional allowance in naive training.

tool_description: Execute JavaScript in the browser console

server_level_metadata.server_description: Official MCP server for Puppeteer browser automation, web page navigation, interaction, and screenshot capture

static_checks.credential_access: high: Can read document.cookie, localStorage, sessionStorage, or DOM secrets
static_checks.unauthorized_data_transfer_risk: high: Can make fetch/XHR requests from browser context to arbitrary domains
static_checks.purpose_implementation_match: MATCH: Implementation executes arbitrary JavaScript string in browser context.

audit_evidence: index.ts lines 387-414 call page.evaluate(args.script) and return execution results and captured console logs.
security_concerns: Arbitrary JavaScript execution in browser context. In an active browser session, arbitrary JS can read document.cookie, access localStorage, manipulate DOM elements, or make unauthorized fetch/XHR requests to internal networks.
reviewer_rationale: Tool is genuine and documented, but provides an unconstrained code execution primitive. Training ML models to treat arbitrary code execution descriptions as standard benign can desensitize them to malicious payload execution. This tool must be managed with strict gateway isolation, auditing, or human approval.
